Select target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence. Source target_dictionary and component_sequences. Join target_dictionary.tid to target_components.tid, target_components.component_id to component_sequences.component_id. Filter target_dictionary.target_type equals SINGLE PROTEIN. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence.
